faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Warangal JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post at NIT Warangal is 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIT Warangal JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the NIT Warangal recruitment drive. This offers a specific opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the JRF post at NIT Warangal?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is 35 years. Age relaxation of up to 5 years is applicable for OBC/SC/ST categories and for women candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at NIT Warangal?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position will receive a salary of Rs. 31,000 per month. This is a contractual position with a fixed monthly stipend.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for NIT Warangal JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post at NIT Warangal. Candidates can apply without any cost.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for NIT Warangal JRF posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Warangal involves two main stages: shortlisting of applications followed by an interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for NIT Warangal JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply offline by downloading the application form from the official website www.nitw.ac.in, filling it out, attaching required documents, and sending it to the specified address before 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential qualifications for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical/Production/Metallurgy (First class) and an M.E./M.Tech in Manufacturing, welding, Production, Metallurgy, CAD-CAM, Design, or a relevant specialization.

faq.question: Q9. When was the NIT Warangal JRF notification released?
faq.answer: The official notification for the NIT Warangal Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment was released on 13 August 2026. All details are available in the official advertisement.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the JRF position at NIT Warangal?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Warangal is a contractual job type. This means the employment is for a specific period as outlined in the project details.
